messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Fourth protocol. Its metabolism is accelerating. The creature does not only ask for food: it also absorbs nearby emotional states.

choices.label: I ration the supply strictly to keep control.
I give it more energy to calm its stress.
I test a secondary source before it depends too much on me.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: It refuses the standard nutrient gel. When you approach, its skin stabilizes. The bond is becoming a resource, not just a symptom.

choices.label: I maintain the procedure despite its refusal.
I modify the formula according to its reactions.
I share a calm contact to reduce the brutal dependency.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Its body responds. The question is no longer only how to feed it, but what kind of lack it will learn to endure.

choices.label: Stabilize its organism first, even if it resists.
Let its instinct find an unknown resource.
Teach it to wait without feeling abandoned.
